semiconductor_relevance: High — Grintimate specializes in high-precision grinding and thinning equipment specifically designed for semiconductor processing.
summary: Grintimate Precision Industry Co., Ltd. is a leading Taiwanese manufacturer of advanced grinding machines tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their equipment is designed for high-precision processing of various materials, including silicon and silicon carbide wafers, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Wafer thinning solutions for 12-inch silicon carbide wafers
Hydrostatic bearing technology for low-wear processing
Ultrasonic-assisted spindles and AI-driven process monitoring

regional_presence.Taiwan: Grintimate is established in Taiwan and is recognized for its innovative grinding solutions in the semiconductor sector.
